translations.web: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
translations.bsb: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.
translations.kjv: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
translations.asv: But thou, O Lord, art a God merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth.
